C0.quote: a voting rule aggregates this data into the final outcome
C0.note: Borderline. The paper studies statistical cultures for generating approval elections, maps of elections, and computational and proportionality properties of rules (AV, PAV) on them. It is coded as about computational aspects of voting procedures.

C1.quote: Our goal is to initiate a systematic study of approval-based statistical cultures
C1.note: Main results are maps and statistics from synthetic elections. Real Pabulib data are compared (EM). Propositions 1-2 give polynomial-time sampling and NP-hardness of the isomorphic Hamming distance (AL).
